title: Pure Dragon Link
summary: Pure Dragon Link combo strategy built around the Rokket and Borrel engine alongside Bystial and Chaos Dragon extenders. By utilizing Striker Dragon, Dragunity Knight - Romulus, and Guardragon Pisty to tutor Field Spells and revive materials, the deck establishes formidable endboards featuring Borrelend Dragon, Bystial Dis Pater, and Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres.

summary.title: Starters
points: Black Metal Dragon is a 1-card starter: sent to the GY to Link Summon Striker Dragon, it searches Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon to begin reviving materials.
Quick Launch Special Summons any Rokket monster (most notably Rokket Tracer) directly from your Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Starliege Seyfert sends Dragons from hand or field to GY to search matching-Level Dragons like Rokket Tracer, Wyverburster, or Collapserpent.
Rokket Tracer destroys any face-up card you control as a Quick Effect to Special Summon another Rokket monster from your Deck, locking your Extra Deck into DARK monsters.

summary.title: Opening: Black Metal Dragon
steps: Normal Summon Black Metal Dragon and Link Summon Striker Dragon.
Trigger Striker Dragon to search Boot Sector Launch and trigger Black Metal Dragon in GY to search Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon.
Banish Striker Dragon to Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon, then activate its effect to revive Black Metal Dragon from your GY.
Link Summon Dragunity Knight - Romulus using Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon and Black Metal Dragon, searching Dragon Ravine.
Activate Dragon Ravine, discarding a card to send Absorouter Dragon from Deck to GY, triggering Absorouter to search Rokket Tracer.

Activate Boot Sector Launch to summon Rokket Tracer from hand, destroy Boot Sector Launch with Tracer to summon Rokket Recharger from Deck, and link into Guardragon Pisty and Dillingerous Dragon to climb into Borrelend Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Borrelend Dragon cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, cannot be targeted by monster effects, attacks all opposing monsters, and negates an effect monster on field as a Quick Effect while reviving a Rokket from your GY.

Bystial Dis Pater is a Level 10 Synchro that targets a banished LIGHT or DARK monster to Special Summon it to your field, and can shuffle a banished card into the Deck to either destroy an activated card or negate a monster effect.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres tributes itself on the opponent's turn to bounce a face-up card on the field without destroying, then Special Summons a Dragon from your Deck with 0 ATK/DEF.
Borrelsword Dragon cannot be destroyed by battle, switches an opponent's monster to Defense Position to attack twice, and steals half of the battling monster's ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Boot Sector Launch boosts all Rokket monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and Special Summons up to 2 Rokket monsters with different names from your hand or GY.
Quick Launch provides unchainable, non-once-per-turn Special Summons of Rokket monsters directly from your Deck.
Chaos Space searches White Dragon Wyverburster or Black Dragon Collapserpent by discarding an opposite-Attribute monster, and recycles a banished monster to draw a card.

allow.Black Metal Dragon: Level 1 DARK Dragon starter that links into Striker Dragon to search Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon from the Deck.
allow.Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon: Banishes Striker Dragon to Special Summon itself and revives Black Metal Dragon from the GY every turn.
allow.Starliege Seyfert: Sends Dragons from hand/field to GY to search Rokket Tracer or Chaos Dragons, and banishes from GY to recover a Level 8 Dragon.
allow.Noctovision Dragon: Special Summons itself when a DARK Dragon is Special Summoned and draws 1 card when used as Link Material.
allow.Absorouter Dragon: Special Summons itself while you control a Rokket monster and searches any Rokket monster from the Deck when sent to the GY.
allow.White Dragon Wyverburster: Banishes a DARK Dragon from GY to Special Summon itself and searches Collapserpent when linked off.
allow.Black Dragon Collapserpent: Banishes a LIGHT Dragon from GY to Special Summon itself and searches Wyverburster when linked off.
allow.Quick Launch: Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons any Rokket monster directly from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
allow.Boot Sector Launch: Field Spell searched by Striker Dragon that Special Summons up to 2 Rokket monsters from hand or GY.
allow.Dragon Ravine: Field Spell searched by Dragunity Knight - Romulus that sends Absorouter Dragon from the Deck to the GY to search Rokket Tracer.
allow.Chaos Space: Searches White Dragon Wyverburster or Black Dragon Collapserpent and draws 1 card.
allow.Bystial Dis Pater: Level 10 Dragon Synchro that Special Summons a banished LIGHT or DARK monster and destroys or negates cards when monsters are banished.
allow.Dragunity Knight - Romulus: Link-2 Dragon that searches Dragon Ravine on Link Summon.
allow.Guardragon Pisty: Link-1 Dragon that Special Summons a banished or GY Dragon to a zone that 2+ Link Monsters point to.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon that bounces a face-up card on the opponent's turn and summons a Dragon from the Deck.

main: Rokket Tracer
Core Level 4 DARK Dragon Tuner that destroys 1 face-up card you control as a Quick Effect to Special Summon any Rokket monster from your Deck.
Rokket Recharger
Discards itself from hand/field when a DARK Extra Deck monster is destroyed to revive a different DARK monster, and summons a DARK monster from hand while Tracer is on the field.
Rokket Caliber
Level 4 DARK Dragon Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand to a zone a DARK Link Monster points to.
Silverrokket Dragon
Destroys itself when targeted by a Link Monster to look at the opponent's Extra Deck and banish 1 card from it.
Magnarokket Dragon
Destroys itself when targeted by a Link Monster to send 1 monster on the field to the GY without targeting.
Absorouter Dragon
Special Summons itself while you control a Rokket and searches Rokket Tracer or Recharger when sent to the GY.
Noctovision Dragon
Special Summons itself when a DARK Dragon is summoned and draws 1 card when used as Link Material.
Black Metal Dragon
One-card Dragon Link starter that links into Striker Dragon to search Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon.
Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Banishes Striker Dragon to summon itself and revives a Dragon from the GY.
Starliege Seyfert
Searches Rokket Tracer or Wyverburster/Collapserpent and recycles Level 8 Dragons from the GY.
White Dragon Wyverburster
LIGHT Chaos Dragon extender that searches Black Dragon Collapserpent.
Black Dragon Collapserpent
DARK Chaos Dragon extender that searches White Dragon Wyverburster.
Quick Launch
Special Summons Rokket Tracer directly from the Deck as a Quick-Play Spell.
Boot Sector Launch
Searched by Striker Dragon; summons up to 2 Rokket monsters from your hand or GY.
Dragon Ravine
Searched by Romulus; dumps Absorouter Dragon from the Deck to search Rokket Tracer.
Chaos Space
Searches Wyverburster or Collapserpent and draws 1 card by recycling a banished monster.
